mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 3.5% triggers investor concerns about economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive despite UNRATE crossing 3.5pp threshold.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices signal economic expansion, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and INDPRO rise.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by FEDFUNDS < 2% and CPIAUCSL < 3%), investors anticipate peak growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive in late-cycle expansion regime (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in employment (PAYEMS) above 150,000 indicates a strong labor market, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not positive when PAYEMS rises above 150k.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained surge in the supply index (INDPRO) above 105 signals over-supply, leading to reduced corporate profits and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
Concurrent rises in labor demand (PAYEMS) and overall demand (GDPC1) indicate robust economic activity, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when both PAYEMS and GDPC1 rise.

mechanism_narrative: During an expansion cycle (FEDFUNDS < 2% and CPIAUCSL < 3%), investors expect sustained growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive in expansion cycle regime (p > 0.05).
